verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order to 'YOUR SPACE / EXPAND'. It drops the red text panel, so the white headline sits straight on the busy photo and 'EXPAND' almost disappears against the white wall. The red shape has shrunk to a meaningless block behind the chairs, and the zigzags are a tiny scrap in the bottom-left corner. B keeps the right order and puts the headline on the red chevron panel, so it reads clearly and stays on brand. Its flaws: the panel cuts awkwardly across the lamps and chairs, the text runs nearly to the panel's right edge with almost no margin, a stray zigzag fragment floats on the left, and there's an unexplained white strip down the right side.
